buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Scope of Work A. Salient Contract Conditions: 1. Name of work: Hiring of Attendant in lieu of TADK. 2. Contract duration: Two years. 3. No. of attendants required: 70 nos 4. Variation in contract will be as per GCC Services 5. Contractor will supply attendants on demand. 6. Individual deployment shall be concurrent with the contract or co-terminus with the posting/eligibility of the officer concerned, whichever is earlier. 7. Scope/duties: Duties broadly corresponding to the erstwhile TADK. 8. Primary place of work: Residence of the officer or other designated place based on requirement. 9. No sub-contracting or assignment shall be permitted without written approval of the Railway. 10. All attendants shall carry a photo Identity card issued by the contractor and maintain a live mobile connection. 11. Consignee is the Contract Management Authority for the contract. B. Eligibility Criteria for Bidders: 1. Work experience: The Bidder must have successfully executed/completed at least one similar singl e service contract of minimum 35% of the advertised bid value during the last three previous finan cial years and the current financial year up to the date of bid opening. Ongoing contracts may be c ounted where paid bills reach the prescribed threshold. Documentary proof of the same should be enclosed by the bidder. Definition of Similar service: Supply/ engagement of manpower for service contracts such as Atte ndant/ housekeeping/ Data Entry Operators or comparable manpower services in Government/ P SU/ Public Limited Company/ Autonomous Body. Work experience certificates from private individ uals shall not be accepted. 2. Financial capacity: The bidder should have an aggregate financial turnover not less than 1.5 times the advertised Bid value during the last three previous financial years and in the current financial year upto the date of opening of the tender. The audited balance sheet reflecting financial turnover certified by chart ered accountant/ cost accountant with her stamp, signature and membership number shall be co nsidered. 3. Liquidity: The bidder should have access to or has available liquid assets, lines of credit and other financial means to meet cash flow that is valued at 5% of the estimated bid value net of applicant's commi tments for other contracts. The audited balance sheet and/or banking reference certified by chart ered accountant/ cost accountant with her stamp, signature and membership number shall be su bmitted by the bidder along with bid. Banking reference should contain in clear terms the amount that bank will be in a position to lend for this work to the bidder. In case the Net Current Assets (a s seen from the Balance Sheets) are negative, only the Banking references will be considered. Ot herwise the aggregate of the Net Current Assets and submitted Banking references will be consid ered for working out the Liquidity. The banking reference should be from a Scheduled Bank in Ind ia and it should not be more than 3 months old as on date of submission of bids in the format giv en in Annexure-H. 4. Financial standing/non banning: The bidder shall not be under bankruptcy, insolvency, liquidation o r court receivership and shall not be banned/ debarred by Government/PSU/Regulatory authority a t the time of submission of bid. The bidders should submit a declaration/ undertaking in this regard including declaration regarding truthfulness and correctness of the documents/ declarations as per

Annexure:G. In case of partnership firm, Annexure:G to be filled by all the partners. 5. JV firms are not allowed to participate. 6. Bidder(s) should specifically and fully disclose in his/their respective tender, their respective consti tutions and submit along with each tender scanned attested copies of documents like partnership deed, Articles and Memorandum of Association, Certificate of Incorporation etc., if any, in support of such disclosures. If Bidder/Bidder(s) is/are a firm i.e. partnership business, it should be stated w hether the same is Registered under the Indian Partnership Act, and the name and address of all th e partners of the firm should be fully disclosed. The Railway Administration shall always have the li berty to demand production of the original partnership deed of the said documents and also to ma ke such further and other inquiries regarding the constitution of the Bidder(s) as may be considere d necessary. The bidder shall clearly specify whether the bid is submitted on his own or on behalf of a partners hip concern. If the bid is submitted on behalf of a partnership concern, he should submit the scan ned copy of the certified copy of partnership deed along with the tender and authorization to sign the tender documents on behalf of partnership firm. If these documents are not enclosed along w ith tender documents, the tender will be treated as having been submitted by individual signing t he tender documents. The Railway will not be bound by any power of attorney granted by the bid der or by changes in the composition of the firm made subsequent to the execution of the contra ct. It may, however recognize such power of attorney and changes after obtaining proper legal ad vice, the cost of which will be chargeable to the contractor. The bidder whether sole proprietor, a limited company or a partnership firm if they want to act th rough agent or individual partner(s) should submit along with the tender or at a later stage, a po wer of attorney duly stamped and authenticated by a Notary Public or by Magistrate in favour of t he specific person whether he/they be partner(s) of the firm or any other person specifically auth orising him/them to submit the tender, sign the agreement, receive money, witness measuremen ts, sign measurement books, compromise, settle, relinquish any claim(s) preferred by the firm an d sign “No Claim Certificate” and refer all or any disputes to arbitration. The bidder shall clearly specify whether the bid is submitted on his own or on behalf of a Partners hip Firm/Joint Venture (JV)/Society etc. The bidder(s) who is /are constituents of Firm, Company, A ssociation or Society shall enclose self-attested copies of the Constitution of their concern, Partne rship Deed and Power of Attorney along with their bid. Bid Documents in such cases shall to be si gned by such persons as may be legally competent, Association of Society, as the case may be. The bidder shall give full details of the constitution of the Firm/JV/Company/Society etc. and shall also submit following documents (as applicable), in addition to document mentioned above: a) Sole Proprietorship Firm: The bidder shall submit the notarised copy of affidavit. b) Partnership Firm: The bidder shall submit self-attested copies of (i) registered/notarised Partnership Deed and (ii) Power of Attorney duly authorising one or more of the partners of the firm or any other p erson(s), authorised by all the partners to act on behalf of the firm and to submit & sign the Bid, sign the agreement, witness measurements, sign Measurement Books,receive paymen t, make correspondences, compromise/ settle/ relinquish any claim(s) preferred by the firm , sign “No Claim Certificate”, refer all or any dispute to arbitration and to take similar actio n in respect of all Bids/contracts OR said Bid/contract. c) Company registered under Companies Act-1956: The Bidder shall submit (i) the copies of MOA (Memorandum of Association) and AOA (Articles of Association) of the C ompany, and (ii) Power of Attorney duly registered/notarised by the Company (backed by the resolution of Board of Directors) in favour the individual, signing the Bid on behalf of the Bidders should especially refer to clause 16 and 17 of Annexure II of GCC for Services while partici

pating for compliance. C. Local office support The contractor shall have a fully functional office at Visakhapatnam. If the Contractor is not having an y office at Visakhapatnam, it will have to establish a fully functional office at Visakhapatnam at its ow n cost within fifteen (15) days from the date of award of contract failing which, their contract will be s ummarily cancelled without any further notice. When the contractor is not personally present on the site of the work place, contractor shall keep a res ponsible agent during working hours who shall on receiving reasonable notice, present himself to the Manager, and orders given by the Manager or the Manager’s representative to the agent shall be dee med to have the same force as if they had been given to the Contactor. Before absenting himself, the contractor shall furnish the name and address of his agent for the purpose of this clause and failure on the part of the Contractor to comply with this provision at any time will entitle the Railway to rescind t he contract under Clause 4.8 of General Conditions of Contract for Services. D. Attendance, Performance Monitoring and Change of Attendant 1. Attendance shall be maintained by the officer concerned in the prescribed register (Annexure-C). Th e officer shall certify the monthly attendance and forward it to the Nodal Officer/ Consignee on the fi rst working day of the following month. The officer shall issue a monthly Satisfactory Performance Certificate in Annexure-D. Breaches suc h as late reporting, full-day absence, failure to provide replacement, indiscipline and damage/theft shall be recorded. 2. The officer may seek change of the Attendant by notice to the contractor. No unilateral change by t he agency shall be made without approval of the officer concerned and intimation to the Contract M anaging Authority. 3. Up to three changes during the currency of the contract may be permitted. Beyond three changes, approval of the concerned PHOD/ DRM/ CWM shall be necessary. E. Suitability and required Documents of the Attendant 1. Hired manpower should have attained 18 years as of the date of engagement. 2. Physical and mental fitness: Medical fitness certificate from a Government Hospital/Railway Hospita l/Railway Health Unit. The person shall be treated as a private candidate and cost, where applicable , shall be borne by the candidate/contractor. 3. Police antecedent verification certificate before deployment. 4. Self-attested Aadhaar/ identity proof and residential proof. 5. Live and working mobile connection at own/agency cost. 6. Suitability shall be assessed and approved by the officer concerned before deployment. 7. The contractor shall issue a photo Identity Card within the period prescribed in the contract. 8. The attendant should be multi-skilled and competent for multi-tasking. They will be attached to ser ving designated officers at their residence/office or other designated place based on requirement f or multitasking jobs assigned by officer to them. 9. The attendant should be fluent in the language spoken by the concerned officer and his/her family, whom he/she will be attached with. 10. The attendant must stay/ reside at nearby locations, so that in urgency they can attend to their dut y promptly. The Concerned officer (for whom he/she is hired) may also allow him to reside in the ou thouse of their residence. 11. The attendant must carry out the duty with full diligence, care, and sincerity and should be obedien t and honest. 12. The attendant engaged by the Agency shall not take part in any Railway staff union or association a ctivities. F. Payment Terms and Mandatory Bill Documents. 1. The contractor shall first pay wages to the Attendant through bank transfer on or before 7th of the f

ollowing month. 2. Railway reimbursement/ payment of the monthly bill shall be processed only against documentary evidence. The monthly bill shall be accompanied by: Wage sheet showing basic wage, DA, deductions and net payment. Certified Attendance Sheet/Certificate. Monthly Satisfactory Performance Certificate. Bank statement/transaction proof evidencing payment of wages. EPF challan and return/ECR and ESIC challan, where applicable. Proof of other statutory contributions/bonus, where applicable. Certificate regarding registration and monthly compliance/update on Shramik Kalyan Portal, w herever applicable. Invoice showing agency/service charges and GST as per Contract. No Claim Certificate for the billing month. Monthly bill document checklist is attached as Annexure-E. 3. TDS and other recoveries shall be made at prevailing rates. The contractor shall maintain statutory records and produce them on demand to Railway or any competent authority. G. Contractor's Obligations 1. The contractor shall be the employer of the deployed personnel and shall be solely responsible for compliance with labour and social-security laws. The Attendant shall not be deemed a Railway emp loyee. 2. The contractor shall not assign/sub-contract the contract without written consent. 3. The contractor shall maintain valid licenses, registrations and permissions throughout the contract period. 4. The contractor shall be responsible for discipline, conduct and acts/omissions of deployed personne l and for grievance redressal of its workers. 5. Railway shall not be liable for compensation for injury/accident of contractor personnel except to th e extent imposed by law; the contractor shall indemnify Railway against claims arising from its pers onnel. 6. The contractor shall furnish identity, address, police verification, education and medical documents and shall issue photo ID cards. 7. The contractor shall deposit statutory contributions within prescribed timelines and submit returns/ challans and payment evidence. 8. The contractor shall update Railway regarding change of address/management and maintain servic e support/contact arrangements. 9. The contractor shall comply with all applicable laws, orders, by-laws, notifications, guidelines and st andards. 10. The bidder shall possess all applicable registrations, licenses, GST registration and shall indicate the SAC of the tendered service. H. Termination of contract: 1. The contract can be terminated/ short-closed by the Railways on account of unsatisfactory services. The unsatisfactory service shall mean and include the non-compliance of any of the obliga tions by the contractor including the conditions as specified in the penalty clauses. In case of any d ispute of any kind, the contractor shall abide by the decision of the Contract Management Authority . Railway has liberty to terminate the contract with a one-month notice without assigning any reaso n. 2. On transfer, retirement, cessation of eligibility or other administrative reason concerning the officer , individual deployment may be discontinued/ co-terminated in accordance with the contract. 3. Material breach, unethical practice, false documents, statutory non-compliance or persistent servic e failure may result in termination and other action under the contract and extant rules. I. Performance Guarantee The successful bidder shall have to submit a Performance Guarantee (PG) valuing 5% of the contract value. He may deposit the same in upto four instalments within 30 (thirty) days from the date of issu

e of Contract. Extension of time for submission of PG beyond 30 (thirty) days and upto the date of sub mission of PG from the date of issue of contract may be given by the Authority who is competent to si gn the contract agreement. However, a penal interest of 15% per annum shall be charged for the dela y beyond 30 (thirty days, i.e. from 31st day after the date of issue of contract. In case the contractor f ails to submit the requisite PG after 60 days from the date of issue of contract, a notice shall be serve d to the contractor to deposit the PG immediately however not exceeding 90 days from the date of iss ue of contract). In case the contractor fails to submit the requisite PG even after 90 days from the date of issue of contract, the contract shall be terminated duly forfeiting EMD and other dues, if any payabl e against that contract. The failed contractor shall be debarred from participating in retender for that work. In case the 60th day is a bank holiday or office closure, the next working day should be consider ed as the last day for submission of the PGs. Decision of Authority competent to sign the Contract Agr eement would be final in case of any dispute. The value of PG to be submitted by the contractor will n ot change for variation upto 25% (either increase or decrease). J. K. Wage Ceiling, Statutory Contributions and Illustrative Monthly Cost 1. Monthly wage payable for the Attendant shall be fixed at the bottom of Level-1 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix (₹18,000) plus DA applicable from time to time. The DA rate declared by the Ministry of Rail ways/Government, as applicable, shall be adopted. The current rate of DA is 63%. 2. Statutory employee and employer contributions shall be regulated strictly as per the applicable law /rules and current statutory wage ceilings. ESIC, Bonus and other contributions shall be paid/reimb ursed only where statutorily applicable. 3. Agency/service charges shall be a minimum of 3.85%. Bids with service/ Agency charge less than 3 .85% shall not be considered. 4. Employer statutory contributions, admissible agency/service charges, GST and other admissible ad ministrative costs are over and above the Railway Board wage ceiling, subject to documentary proo f and applicable law. 5. Only statutory variation in taxes/duties/contribution rates and change in DA shall be considered for reimbursement/variation, on production of documentary evidence, unless otherwise provided in the governing contract.
